substantive_difference: No prior design/API. Four corner-to-side ownership relations; only two-cell runs at each end, central five-cell portions untouched. Not a uniformly recolored ring; no photograph artwork, tile fill, seam, count or inner boundary edited.
new_feature: Use four side color groups on short existing outer-edge runs, assigning each real corner to both adjacent sides and inviting duplicate corner counting.
